facts.text: Languages spoken here include Belarusian and Russian.
It is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe.

culture.text: Belarusian straw weavers make baskets, hats, toys and symbolic decorations, passing skills through families and craft communities.

food.text: Potato pancakes are a familiar dish to discover in Belarusian cooking.
